decisions.reason: Rye country bread is an everyday staple of a traditional German bakery with steady demand and low cost to keep in the range.
Seeded rye mixed bread shares production with the existing rye range and serves established health-oriented demand.
Dark malt rye is a niche traditional variety that is somewhat exposed to range pruning but still cheap to maintain.
Even though the premium raisin stollen was dropped, marzipan stollen remains a classic seasonal gift item, though the stollen line is evidently under review.
The ancient grain 'Meisterstück' fits the heritage-grain and health trend and supports the bakery's craft quality image.
